investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 13(1) of the of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that the any equipment in respect of which the offence was committed shall be liable to be forfeited.
(II) Section 83(1) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that in England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.
